reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Wisconsin, focus year 2021)

    Question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate floating home landlords?

    Statutes provided:
      [1] WI Stat  710.15 (2021) Manufactured and mobile home community regulations
      [2] WI Stat  134.02 (2021) Blacklisting and coercion of employees (not eviction-related)
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% -----------------------------

jurisdiction(wisconsin).
focus_year(2021).

% The "question scenario" we test: a floating home landlord exists in Wisconsin.
% (The question asks whether eviction law explicitly regulates floating home landlords.)
scenario_floating_home_landlord(ll1).
scenario_state(wisconsin).

% A floating home landlord rents floating home berths/sites (marina context).
rents_site_type(ll1, floating_home_site).
landlord_type(ll1, floating_home_landlord).

% Define the home/site types relevant to the statutes.
home_type(mobile_home).
home_type(manufactured_home).
home_type(floating_home).

% Explicit disjointness for this task: floating homes are not mobile/manufactured homes.
% (Used to avoid accidental inclusion when reasoning about statute scope.)
distinct_home_type(floating_home, mobile_home).
distinct_home_type(floating_home, manufactured_home).
distinct_home_type(mobile_home, manufactured_home).

scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(wisconsin),
    focus_year(2021),
    scenario_state(wisconsin),
    scenario_floating_home_landlord(L),
    landlord_type(L, floating_home_landlord),
    rents_site_type(L, floating_home_site).

% -----------------------------
% Statute modeling: WI Stat  710.15 (2021)
% -----------------------------

% Identify the statute as an object we can reason about.
eviction_related_statute(wi_stat_710_15_2021).  % This one governs termination/nonrenewal for mobile/manufactured home communities.

% WI Stat  710.15(1): Definitions (modeled as type constraints and thresholds)

%  710.15(1)(ad): "Community" means tract of land containing 3+ plots where mobile/manufactured homes are located for rent/fee pursuant to a lease.
statute_710_15_is_community(Community) :-
    community_plots(Community, PlotCount),
    PlotCount >= 3,
    community_home_type(Community, HomeType),
    statute_710_15_regulated_home_type(HomeType),
    community_has_lease_for_rent_or_fee(Community).

%  710.15 regulates only mobile homes and manufactured homes (not floating homes).
statute_710_15_regulated_home_type(mobile_home).
statute_710_15_regulated_home_type(manufactured_home).

%  710.15(1)(d): "Operator" means engaged in business of renting plots or mobile/manufactured homes in a community.
statute_710_15_is_operator(Operator, Community) :-
    statute_710_15_is_community(Community),
    operator_engaged_in_business_renting(Operator, Community),
    (
        operator_rents_plots_of_ground(Operator, Community)
    ;
        operator_rents_homes_in_community(Operator, Community)
    ).

%  710.15(1)(ag): "Lease" is written agreement between operator and resident for siting/occupancy in community.
statute_710_15_is_lease(Lease, Operator, Resident, Community) :-
    statute_710_15_is_operator(Operator, Community),
    lease_written(Lease),
    lease_between(Lease, Operator, Resident),
    lease_for_home_siting_or_occupancy(Lease, Community).

%  710.15(1m): Every agreement for rental of a mobile/manufactured home site shall be by lease;
% every lease shall be for term >= 1 year unless resident/occupant requests shorter and operator agrees.
statute_710_15_lease_term_compliant(Lease) :-
    lease_term_months(Lease, Months),
    Months >= 12, !.
statute_710_15_lease_term_compliant(Lease) :-
    lease_term_months(Lease, Months),
    Months < 12,
    resident_requested_shorter_term(Lease),
    operator_agreed_shorter_term(Lease).

%  710.15(2): All community rules that substantially affect rights/duties shall be made part of every lease.
statute_710_15_rules_included_in_lease_required(Lease, Community) :-
    statute_710_15_is_community(Community),
    lease_applies_to_community(Lease, Community),
    community_rules_substantially_affect_rights_or_duties(Community),
    lease_includes_community_rules(Lease, Community).

%  710.15(5m): Exclusive grounds for termination/nonrenewal in a community.
statute_710_15_termination_ground(failure_to_pay_rent_or_charges).            % (a)
statute_710_15_termination_ground(disorderly_conduct_disruption).            % (b)
statute_710_15_termination_ground(vandalism_or_waste).                       % (c)
statute_710_15_termination_ground(breach_of_lease_term).                     % (d)
statute_710_15_termination_ground(health_safety_endangerment_rules_after_notice). % (e)
statute_710_15_termination_ground(law_violation_after_notice).               % (em)
statute_710_15_termination_ground(retire_community_permanently).             % (f)
statute_710_15_termination_ground(required_to_discontinue_use_by_authorities). % (g)
statute_710_15_termination_ground(physical_condition_threat_or_disruptive).  % (h)
statute_710_15_termination_ground(refusal_to_sign_lease).                    % (i)
statute_710_15_termination_ground(material_misrepresentation_application).   % (j)
statute_710_15_termination_ground(other_good_cause).                         % (k)

% For reasoning: if 710.15 applies to an operator/community, it "explicitly regulates" that operator's eviction/termination conduct.
statute_710_15_explicitly_regulates_operator_eviction(Operator) :-
    statute_710_15_is_operator(Operator, _Community).

% -----------------------------
% Statute modeling: WI Stat  134.02 (2021) (not eviction-related)
% -----------------------------

non_eviction_statute(wi_stat_134_02_2021).

% A minimal encoding of the statute's regulated conduct: employers combining to blacklist/coerce.
% (Included because it was provided, but it does not answer the eviction question.)
statute_134_02_prohibited_combination_purpose(prevent_obtaining_employment).     % (1)(a)
statute_134_02_prohibited_combination_purpose(procure_discharge_by_blacklist).  % (1)(b)
statute_134_02_prohibited_combination_purpose(prevent_future_employment).       % (1)(c)
statute_134_02_prohibited_combination_purpose(authorize_agent_blacklist).       % (1)(d)
statute_134_02_prohibited_combination_purpose(circulate_blacklist_voluntary_left). % (1)(e)
statute_134_02_prohibited_combination_purpose(coerce_no_union_condition).       % (1)(f)

% -----------------------------
% General reasoning helpers
% -----------------------------

% Determine which home types are explicitly within the eviction-related statute scope.
eviction_statute_regulated_home_type(Statute, HomeType) :-
    Statute = wi_stat_710_15_2021,
    statute_710_15_regulated_home_type(HomeType).

% Convert "landlord types" to "home/site types" they rent for this question.
landlord_rented_home_type(Landlord, floating_home) :-
    landlord_type(Landlord, floating_home_landlord),
    rents_site_type(Landlord, floating_home_site).

landlord_rented_home_type(Landlord, mobile_home) :-
    landlord_type(Landlord, mobile_home_community_operator),
    rents_site_type(Landlord, mobile_home_site).

landlord_rented_home_type(Landlord, manufactured_home) :-
    landlord_type(Landlord, manufactured_home_community_operator),
    rents_site_type(Landlord, manufactured_home_site).

% "Explicitly regulates floating home landlords" if an eviction-related statute explicitly covers floating homes
% (or floating home landlords as such). With the provided statutes, coverage is by home type.
explicitly_regulates_floating_home_landlords :-
    scenario_floating_home_landlord(Landlord),
    landlord_rented_home_type(Landlord, floating_home),
    eviction_related_statute(Statute),
    eviction_statute_regulated_home_type(Statute, floating_home).

% -----------------------------
% Answer predicate (must be deterministic)
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    explicitly_regulates_floating_home_landlords,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Placeholder facts for statute predicates (not part of scenario)
% -----------------------------
% These are declared only to keep the program self-contained; no scenario asserts them.

% Community/operator/lease structure (unused by scenario but required by statute predicates)
community_plots(_Community, 0).
community_home_type(_Community, mobile_home) :- fail.
community_home_type(_Community, manufactured_home) :- fail.
community_has_lease_for_rent_or_fee(_Community) :- fail.
operator_engaged_in_business_renting(_Operator, _Community) :- fail.
operator_rents_plots_of_ground(_Operator, _Community) :- fail.
operator_rents_homes_in_community(_Operator, _Community) :- fail.
lease_written(_Lease) :- fail.
lease_between(_Lease, _Operator, _Resident) :- fail.
lease_for_home_siting_or_occupancy(_Lease, _Community) :- fail.
lease_term_months(_Lease, 0).
resident_requested_shorter_term(_Lease) :- fail.
operator_agreed_shorter_term(_Lease) :- fail.
lease_applies_to_community(_Lease, _Community) :- fail.
community_rules_substantially_affect_rights_or_duties(_Community) :- fail.
lease_includes_community_rules(_Lease, _Community) :- fail.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -----------------------------
main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does state/territory eviction law explicitly regulate floating home landlords?
